announcements.headline: EQS-News: SGL Carbon: Business performance in Q3 2026 supports an upward revision of the full-year earnings forecast
announcements.insight: SGL Carbon revises its full-year earnings forecast upward, following preliminary sales updates in October. This positive guidance change supports earlier claims of meeting annual targets.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: SGL Carbon SE: Preliminary announcement of the publication of quarterly reports and quarterly/interim statements
announcements.insight: SGL Carbon SE announces the publication of quarterly reports. This follows its October preliminary sales update and August confirmation of meeting annual targets.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: SGL Carbon sells its former Carbon Fiber facility in Moses Lake (USA)
announcements.insight: SGL Carbon disposes of its US facility. This follows preliminary sales updates and confirms progress toward meeting annual targets.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: SGL Carbon SE reports preliminary sales and earnings figures for the first nine months and raises its forecast for 2026
announcements.insight: SGL Carbon SE raises its 2026 forecast following earlier confirmation it remained on track to meet annual targets. This guidance change suggests improved performance for shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: SGL Carbon: Still on track to meet its 2026 annual targets
announcements.insight: SGL Carbon SE confirms it remains on track to meet its 2026 annual targets. This follows a preliminary announcement regarding the publication of financial reports in July 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: SGL Carbon SE: Preliminary announcement of the publication of financial reports according to Articles 114, 115, 117 of the WpHG [the German Securities Act]
announcements.insight: SGL Carbon SE has published its financial reports as required by German law. Shareholders should await further details regarding the content of these filings.
